children: C3.ai, Inc. reported first-quarter 2026 results in its 10-Q showing revenue of $52.38M, down from $70.26M in the prior-year quarter, and a net loss of ($92.81M) versus a ($116.77M) loss a year earlier; diluted EPS was ($0.6) compared with ($0.86) in the year-ago quarter.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Subscription-led revenue fell 18% year-over-year to $49.2M; total revenue decreased 25% driven by lower professional services.
Company is shifting toward consumption-based pricing (vCPU/vGPU) and shorter proofs-of-value to broaden adoption.
Go-to-market changes include a sales reorganization and expanded partnerships with hyperscalers and consultancies such as Microsoft, AWS, Google and McKinsey.
Operational restructuring under a February 2026 plan reduced headcount, cut costs, and realigned R&D to prioritized industry use cases.
Marketing focus on agentic/generative AI along with growing federal/defense traction and international revenue (about 20% of Q1 2027 revenue).
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
